llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store uses `persist` with `createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage)` and persists only token state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: persist middleware uses createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage) and partialize limits persistence to token only

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store state includes `hasHydrated` `token` `profileStatus` `profileName` and hydration setter action
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Store has _hasHydrated and setHasHydrated but uses isLoadingProfile instead of profileStatus; profileName is present but profileStatus field is absent

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Login action performs `POST` request to auth login endpoint and writes returned token into store
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: login action POSTs to https://dummyjson.com/auth/login and writes returned accessToken/token into store via set({ token })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile fetch request sends `Authorization` bearer header built from persisted token
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: fetchProfile reads token from store and sets Authorization: Bearer ${token} header on the profile request

llmJudgeRequirements.description: onRehydrateStorage sets hydrated flag in success and error paths and reloads profile when token exists
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onRehydrateStorage callback calls setHasHydrated(true) and fetchProfile only inside the if (state) branch; the error path (when state is falsy or error is non-null) never sets the hydrated flag
evidence: no else branch handling error case

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI renders hydration loading branch when `hasHydrated` is false
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: UI checks !hasHydrated and returns a loading screen with ActivityIndicator before rendering the main content

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI renders profile loading branch when token exists and `profileStatus` is loading
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: UI renders a profile loading branch with ActivityIndicator when isAuthenticated (token exists) and isLoadingProfile is true
